description: Out-of-band allowlist of public keys authorized to sign MLGG execution attestations. Copy this file to trusted_signers.json and fill in your own key fingerprints. The attestation gate REQUIRES the signing public key's SHA-256 fingerprint to appear here and to be active (not revoked, within active window) — otherwise signature verification alone is a no-op since the attacker controls the key material inside the bundle.
how_to_compute_fingerprint: openssl pkey -pubin -in your_pub.pem -outform DER | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | xxd -p -c 256

signers.signer_name: MLGG Release Key 2026 (example — replace with yours)
signers.notes: Primary release-signing key. Rotate annually; add new entry instead of editing an existing one so audit history stays intact.
